gaps.confirmed_evidence: rg for Real Signal/real_signal found no existing implementation or issue-exact report before this task card/report bundle.
gaps.impact: No single calibrated Real Signal scorecard currently separates actionable signals from heuristic-only or DATA_MISSING states.

gaps.confirmed_evidence: Composite score uses retrieval precision, model confidence, and session coherence weights.
gaps.impact: A high score could be misread as verified signal quality if surfaced without provenance and DATA_MISSING gates.
gaps.recommended_next_step: Treat chat quality score as heuristic input only.

gaps.confirmed_evidence: Signals include confidence/materiality/persistence and route_signals can update memory stores.
gaps.impact: Memory signals can be useful context but must not satisfy claim verification or canonical financial truth.
gaps.recommended_next_step: Use memory signals only as context in report-local scoring and do not execute route_signals.

gaps.confirmed_evidence: SOURCE_READY text says inspectable context, not verified financial truth.
gaps.impact: News readiness can support inspectability/freshness but cannot verify financial metrics.
gaps.recommended_next_step: Map SOURCE_READY to INSPECTABLE_CONTEXT unless claim verification is separately present.

gaps.confirmed_evidence: Current confirmed metric extracted-payload score remains DATA_MISSING.
